title: Config-driven ingestion - one TOML per lane, thin strategies, one runner, cron runtime, LayerService serving
description: Cap legacy soil first (G0: 33 logical requests per run, probe-gated frontier, probe faults exit 0, requests/weighted calls/HTTP attempts reported) before the paid Open-Meteo key is set; then replace per-lane forward modules and scattered lane facts with typed lane TOML (shipped by the Dockerfile and digested by the receipt), a strategy Protocol in pipeline/runner/contract.py resolved by import-path convention and one shared runner with a probe-gated forward fan-out and per-mode per-turn caps; unify forward and gap-fill; transforms as persisted input-driven lanes; a session-per-lane work-queue executor with a split breaker (incident rows only); a LayerService registry over parquet_ops via sanic-ext DI; new streams registered through a TOML-checked mirror; climate meteorology re-sourced to Open-Meteo ERA5 (explicit nodes on the manifest's 0.25 deg analysis lattice) plus an IFS tail ending yesterday UTC, solar on NASA POWER UTC re-gridded plus an IFS tail; water gauges moved early to USGS daily values with history to 1990-09-30; the remaining lanes cut over by a reviewed swarm; per-lane production QA and validation; then the legacy path deleted.
revision_note: review loop 1 folded in (spec section 14); review loop 2 and owner decisions O8-O10 folded in (spec sections 3.4, 15); review loop 3 (CHANGES-REQUIRED, G0 NOT READY) and round-3 owner decisions O-R3-1..3 folded in (spec sections 3.5, 16): probe faults exit 0, thin fan-out raise stated, run-level test harness named, G0 accounting, p4-extract import closure, no worktree; next review is a targeted re-check of P1-P9 and the G0 brief

owner_decisions_20260926.D1_config: one TOML per lane under services/agri-data-service/lanes/, type-validated at startup and by a contract test; enabled lives in the file; env kill-switch kept; config = data, strategy = behaviour
owner_decisions_20260926.D2_strategy: thin strategy (plan_requests, fetch, settle -> written|absent|unsettled, rows), fat runner (windows, budget, concurrency, per-unit retries, 429 series, unwritten report, writing + receipts, tiers); runner supplies the neighbour-day census
owner_decisions_20260926.D3_one_path: forward and gap-fill are one code path over different day windows
owner_decisions_20260926.D4_transforms: kind=transform lanes, inputs=[...], persisted, input-driven, may chain
owner_decisions_20260926.D5_serving: LayerService Protocol + default config-driven implementation + keyed registry via sanic-ext app.ext.add_dependency; UI reads layer metadata from the API
owner_decisions_20260926.D6_runtime: parsed cron only; bounded parallelism with per-lane locks; split breaker; runnable printed command; child failure detail in the ledger
owner_decisions_20260926.D8_climate: meteorology -> Open-Meteo ERA5 settled + ECMWF IFS provisional + precedence transform on the 0.25 deg lattice; solar stays NASA POWER UTC + IFS tail; POWER soil wetness retired
owner_decisions_20260926.D9_water_gauges: USGS modern Water Data API; retry 503s; per-tile independence
owner_decisions_20260926.D10_migration: framework -> two adversarial loops -> swarm batch cut-over with per-lane reviews -> per-lane production QA + validation -> deprecation

spec_decisions.S16: runtime switches DISPATCH=queue|serial, BREAKER_MODE=split|legacy, MAX_CONCURRENT_LANES; _unwritten_entries reads legacy keys and S5
spec_decisions.S17: quiescent pushes in one shared checkout, no worktrees (O-R3-3): a service-tree commit is made only when the tree's uncommitted changes are exactly that commit's files; p4-extract runs sequentially after G4's push; rollbacks during multi-slice windows use the ledger brake until the next quiescent point

spec_decisions.S19: probe-gated forward fan-out: fan out only when the probe shows a valued day the census still owes, so a probe-unsettled day is never fanned out; a probe that cannot answer gates the window and the turn exits 0 (O-R3-1); a partial fan-out is refused_partial in the runner but raises (exit 1) in legacy G0; per-mode per-turn caps forward_max_weighted_calls and gap_fill_max_weighted_calls

budget_headline.weight_rule: locations x models x max(1, days/14) x max(1, variables/10); >= 1.0 per location per request (O10); weighted calls charged once per logical request, HTTP attempts counted separately
budget_headline.legacy_soil_pre_g0_per_day: <= 244,608 (forward 24 x 5 x 1,568 + repair 4 x 9 x 1,568); throttled today by the free tier's 10,000/day
budget_headline.legacy_soil_per_run_after_g0: <= 33 logical requests, <= 1,602 weighted hard / 1,570 on a clean fan-out (probe 2 + fan-out 1,568; re-check R4), <= 132 fetch attempts (<= 1,584 HTTP requests incl. transport retries and redirect hops) (33 x MAX_FETCH_ATTEMPTS 4)
budget_headline.interim_ceiling_per_day: <= 44,856 hard (28 x 1,602; 43,960 clean = 24 x 1,570 forward + 4 x 1,570 repair); realistic 1,616 only once no owed day older than the probe window remains (the G0 hole-count row, taken before the key)
budget_headline.after_g1_ceiling_per_day: <= 6,408 hard (4 x 1,602; 6,280 clean); realistic 1,576 with no older backlog
budget_headline.failure_episode: <= 24,030 once hard (3 buckets x 5 attempts x 1,602; 23,550 clean)
budget_headline.steady_state_per_month: 162,720 + W (3.3% + W); <= 210,720 + W with soil gap-fill at its cap
